content.title: Betting search salience and conditional SEIR scenarios in Ghana: a time-series public-proxy analysis
content.abstract: Understanding temporal changes in betting-related behavior is important for characterizing digital engagement with gambling in Ghana, yet direct monthly measures of population-level betting participation remain unavailable. This study therefore investigates betting-search salience using a preserved 72-month Google Trends composite spanning January 2020 to December 2025 and complements the empirical analysis with conditional SEIR-type behavioral scenarios. Six parsimonious autoregressive specifications were evaluated using an expanding validation period covering 2023–2024, with model selection
